source_text: Deus qui Adam ex limo fuerat fabricatus, Evam construxit e costa, et dixit: Haec vocabitur Vita, quoniam mater est omnium viventium. Prima appellatione, cui operi parata esset, ostendit et dixit: Crescite et multiplicamini et replete terram. Deus igitur maris creator et feminae convenientia generationibus membra formavit et gigni corpora de corporibus ordinavit, quorum tamen efficientiae potentia operationis intervenit, omne quod est ea administrans virtute, qua condidit. Si igitur nonnisi per sexum fetus, nonnisi per corpus sexus, nonnisi per Deum corpus, quis ambigat fecunditatem Deo iure reputari?
pass_a_gloss: God therefore, creator of male and female, formed members suited to generations and ordained that bodies be begotten from bodies, yet the power of his working intervenes in their making, administering everything that is by that same virtue by which he founded it. God who had fashioned Adam from mud built Eve from a rib and said: She will be called Life, because she is mother of all the living.
pass_b_english: God, who formed Adam from mud, built Eve from a rib and said: “She will be called Life, because she is the mother of all the living” (Genesis 2:7, 22; Genesis 3:20).
From the first naming he showed the task for which she had been prepared, and said: “Increase and multiply and fill the earth” (Genesis 1:28).

Therefore God, the Creator of male and female, formed organs suited to procreation and arranged for bodies to be born from bodies. Yet the power of his action works in their production, governing everything that exists by the same power by which he created it.
If, then, offspring come only through sex, sex only through the body, and the body only through God, who can doubt that fruitfulness is rightly attributed to God?

choices.why: Julian's forensic/moral fault tied to will, not a substance in nature.

anf_compare.notes: Victorian English of some of Julian survives inside NPNF Augustine (chiefly On Marriage and Concupiscence and related anti-Pelagian books). NPNF was not copied.
